subject: hm-pdf-commands
description: pdf-sdk's edit commands (docs/formats/hm-pdf-plan.md). input.plan is an hm-pdf-plan document and input.command an hm-pdf-command; expected is the resulting document, or the rejection. Applying the command's inverse must restore the plan, but the inverse itself is internal. Positions and sizes are whole millionths of the page. Generated cases come from the reducer's property-test generators, with a fixed seed.
